content: दग्ध, -दग्धिका See under दह्. ˚रथः (= चित्ररथः) <ab>N.</ab> of a Gandharva.

दग्ध {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [दह्-क्त] .²1 Burnt, consumed by fire. .²2 (<ab>Fig.</ab>) Consumed by grief, tormented, distressed; (मही) न शक्यते द्रष्टुमपि प्रवासिभिः प्रियावियोगानलदग्धमानसैः <ls>Ṛs. 1. 10</ls>. .²3 Famished. .²4 Inauspicious, as in दग्धयोग. .²5 Dry, tasteless, insipid .²6 Wretched, accursed, vile, (used as a term of abuse before a word); नाद्यापि मे दग्धदेहः पतति <ls>U. 4</ls>; अस्य दग्धोदरस्यार्थे कः कुर्यात् पातकं महत् <ls>H. 1. 68</ls>; so दग्धजठरस्यार्थे <ls>Bh. 3. 8</ls>. .²7 Cunning (विदग्ध). .{@-ग्धा@} .²1 The quarter where the sun remains overhead. .²2 A lunar day or तिथि on which it is considered inauspicious or unlucky to do any act. .{@-ग्धम्@} .²1 Burning; <ls>Mb. 12. 303. 6</ls>. .²2 Cauterizing.
